blurb: Driftwood Landing is a waterfront bar and restaurant located on the Laguna Madre in South Padre Island, Texas. They offer private fishing charters departing from their location. Guests can enjoy drinks at the bar and have their fresh catch cleaned at the fish cleaning station after fishing.
